The error occurs because R8 code shrinking is enabled on release builds (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), which by default removes generic signature metadata from class files. When `CatalogRepository` instantiates `object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}`, Gson's `TypeToken` relies on reflection (`getGenericSuperclass()`) to inspect the type argument. Without generic signatures preserved, `TypeToken` throws `IllegalStateException`. In addition, R8 would obfuscate model fields that Gson accesses via reflection.

The issue has been resolved in [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-B-r4/work/app/proguard-rules.pro) by configuring the following R8 rules:

- `-keepattributes Signature`: Preserves generic signatures across classes and methods so Gson can extract generic type arguments at runtime.
- `-keepattributes *Annotation*,InnerClasses,EnclosingMethod`: Retains annotations and inner class relationships required for anonymous class reflection.
- `-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }` & `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }`: Prevents R8 from shrinking or stripping `TypeToken` subclasses.
- `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`: Preserves the data model classes and their fields so Gson can deserialize JSON keys into model properties.
